I102024.desc: "I saw the Rouges' Brand Director among the raiders. She held an egg against her chest. I could feel it—the faint, godly warmth that spread from within it.  Ah... I think I may understand what she slaughtered us all to accomplish..."
I102024.name: A Noir's Note
I102024.statText: After <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> in the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 on the next attack (5 seconds cooldown)

I104002.desc: An outfit given by the Happy Closet. Let's hand it over to the Arc Floor Lamp.
I104002.name: Clothes from the Happy Closet

I104003.desc: A scrap of paper recovered from the remains of the Happy Closet. The word "Happiness" is written upon it. It served no structural purpose, yet it helped the Happy Closet to continue to exist.
I104003.name: Scrap of Paper

I104004.desc: The vessel that once held the Happy Closet's wish to go on existing.
I104004.name: Red Ruby Heart

I104005.desc: Every customer and employee in the department store is already undergoing their own Distortion. Since the terminus of Distortion is an Abnormality, the true abnormality would be if no Abnormalities had appeared here.
I104005.name: The Egg of an Abnormality that Scattered Pink Petals
I104005.statText:
In the Symbolic, when landing a hit using <color=#F8C200>Basic Attack</color> on the enemy, inflict <color=#F8C200>Petal Mark</color>
- This effect is inflicted only when the enemy does not have this <color=#F8C200>Mark</color>
- <color=#F8C200>Petal Mark</color> lasts for 10 seconds
- Petal Mark cooldown: 10 seconds (counts from the moment the mark is inflicted)
- Meursault's <color=#F8C200>Basic Attack</color> deals +1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> against targets inflicted with Petal Mark
- When a target that has this mark is defeated, deal 5 <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> on 3 x 3 tiles centered on the target

I104006.desc: A button fashioned from Golden Resin.
I104006.name: Golden Button

I104007.desc: A tooth stitched together with Golden Hide.
I104007.name: Golden Tooth

I104008.desc: Hair drawn out into strands of gold.
I104008.name: Golden Hair

I1201.desc: The Crimson God's old Voice plays again, repeating what it once recited. It is the Voice the Rouges once heard. Those of stronger faith could hear a more profound story.
I1201.name: Audiotape

I1206.desc: Scissors divide existence through the joining of opposites.
I1206.name: Well-sharpened Sewing Scissors

I1207.desc: This customer has proven to be an exemplary patron of Le Noir and has contributed to the preservation of the brand's value.
I1207.name: Le Noir Authenticity Certificate

I1208.desc: When light spilled through the cracks and touched everyone, the people in the department store began to change. They took the shape of the values they pursued, the shape of the values pursued by the brands they followed. Those who lost their reason in the transformation came to be called Mannequins. In essence, however, they were no different from the rest of us.
I1208.name: Black-and-Red Thread
I1208.statText:
Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +1

<color=#fe4b48>Attack Speed</color> +10% in the Symbolic

<color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> +5% in the Symbolic

Against Le Noir Sales Associate [Sunshone] and Le Rouge Sales Associate [Sunshone]-type enemies in the Symbolic:
- <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -1
- <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1

I1209.desc: The Alterationist cuts fabric, then joins it again according to the pattern. The snipping has grown much louder of late—the Noirs must have placed an enormous order. Perhaps a major conflict is about to break out?
I1209.name: Tempered Sewing Scissors
I1209.statText:
In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger <color=#F8C200>Scissors-snip Extra Attack</color> dealing 1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> upon landing an attack (0.3 seconds Hitstun)

Upon entering battle in the Shadowed, inflicts on all enemies <color=#F8C200>Bleed</color> Count equal to the number of times they were struck by this effect (max 5)

I990001.desc: A nail. Nails fix their targets in place. Without a hammer, they cannot be driven in. Yet those who throw themselves upon a nail will pin themselves down, hammer or no hammer.
I990001.name: Nail
I990001.statText:
In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Weakpoint Attack</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1
Weakpoint Attack: Triggers when attacking an enemy from behind (excluding certain enemies)

I990002.desc: A hammer. It allows a nail to fulfill its purpose. Yet even alone, a hammer serves just as well as an instrument of destruction.
I990002.name: Hammer
I990002.statText:
<color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1 in the Symbolic
During battle in the Shadowed, deal +10% <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> against enemies that have <color=#F8C200>Bind</color>

I990004.desc: People speak of experiencing the present. Yet if experience is the act of anticipating what is to come and seeing it realized, then it must always lie in the future.
I990004.name: Pulsation
I990004.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Parry</color> in the Symbolic
- Parry: While controlling Meursault, hit the enemy 0.2 seconds before its attack to cancel the attack (excluding certain attacks)

Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Block</color> in the Symbolic
- Block: Press and hold <color=#F8C200>Block</color> (C on keyboard) to maintain Meursault's <color=#F8C200>Block</color> stance
- While <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color>, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -30% from the <color=#fe4b48>Blocked</color> direction

Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> for <color=#F8C200>Avant</color> Attack in the Symbolic
- After activating Avant, <color=#F8C200>repeat the attack</color> to activate Attack Chain 2
- <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>: <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 and <color=#F8C200>Hitstun</color> +0.1 seconds against the enemy

I990006.desc: You ask whether the Alterationist ought to remain neutral? The Noirs favor fabric, while the Rouges prefer hide. Think about it: which brand, then, needs the Alterationist more... and to whom will she be more willing to give her scissors?
I990006.name: Dull Sewing Scissors

I990008.desc: Symbol of Wings. To become free.
I990008.name: Yi Sang
I990008.statText:
<color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> +10% in the Symbolic

In the Symbolic, upon landing an attack, target's <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt -1 for 5 seconds (10 seconds cooldown)

I990009.desc: Symbol of Knowledge. To become clever.
I990009.name: Faust

I990010.desc: Symbol of Action. To become vigorous.
I990010.name: Don Quixote
I990010.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 5% Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> upon killing an enemy (10 seconds cooldown)

I990011.desc: Symbol of Affection and Resentment. To <s>sever</s> twine.
I990011.name: Ryōshū
I990011.statText:
In the Symbolic, 20% chance to inflict 1 <color=#F8C200>Fragile Mark</color> upon landing an attack
(<color=#F8C200>Fragile Mark</color>: <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken +10%)

I990012.name: Hong Lu
I990012.statText: Upon entering battle in the Shadowed via Meursault's Attack, all allies on the field <color=#F8C200>heal 5~10 SP</color>

I990013.desc: Symbol of the Storm. To remember !@#!$.
I990013.name: Heathcliff
I990013.statText:
<color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> +10% in the Symbolic

In the Symbolic, Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 for 20 seconds upon killing an enemy (30 seconds cooldown)

I990014.desc: Symbol of Adventure. To set sail.
I990014.name: Ishmael
I990014.statText: In the Symbolic, upon landing an attack, reduce target's <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> by 20% for 10 seconds (13 seconds cooldown)

I990015.desc: Symbol of the Hero. To await.
I990015.name: Rodion
I990015.statText: If target has 50%+ Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>, Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1

I990016.name: Sinclair
I990016.statText:
In the Symbolic:
- <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 against enemies in the front
- <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -2 from enemies behind

I990017.name: Outis
I990017.statText: If the target has lower than 50% Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1

I990018.name: Gregor
I990018.statText: At lower than 25% Symbolic HP, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 15 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> and <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -20% for the next 10 seconds (19 seconds cooldown)

I990101.desc: Do you remember the first crack that appeared in the walls of the Grand Magasin?
I990101.name: Le Noir Contemporary Cardigan

I990102.desc: The Grand Magasin must be eternally preserved.
I990102.name: Le Noir Contemporary Hat

I990103.desc: The cracks spread wider, multiplying. Why?
I990103.name: Le Noir Contemporary Gentleman Hat
I990103.statText:
If no player inputs are made, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 1 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> every 5 seconds (3 times)
- Rest at the Fount to recharge

I990105.desc: I can no longer hear the Crimson God's Voice...
I990105.name: Le Rouge Casualwear Skirt

I990106.desc: The Rouges find value and meaning in life and every pulse of it. They wait in anticipation for experience.
I990106.name: Le Rouge Contemporary Zipper
I990106.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Sprint</color> in the Symbolic
- Sprint: <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> +30%

I990107.desc: Red is blood, flesh, and hide.
I990107.name: Le Rouge Contemporary Socks
I990107.statText:
Upon entering battle in the Shadowed, inflicts 2 <color=#F8C200>Bleed</color> Potency and +2 <color=#F8C200>Bleed</color> Count on all enemies

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +1

I990108.desc: Those who heard the Voice of warmth turned into Mannequins. Of those, the ones held deepest in the Voice's embrace are able to take one step farther.
I990108.name: Huge Sharp Needle (43cm)

I990110.desc: At Grand Magasin Sisyphe, food is not consumed for energy or survival. It is taken for one purpose alone: to sate the hunger of the heart.
I990110.name: Energy Drink
I990110.statText: In the Symbolic, if 5 seconds have elapsed without attacking after landing a hit on the enemy, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +3 on the next attack

I990111.desc: Oh, the crack is closing. Sealing the breach is the gold—the Resin of Gold.
I990111.name: Le Noir Contemporary Long Socks
I990111.statText:
Unlocks Level 2 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> in the Symbolic
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Time: 2.5 seconds
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>: Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> +2 in the Symbolic

I990112.desc: Protect the Golden Resin. The Golden Resin, in turn, keeps the Grand Magasin from collapsing. A simple chain of cause and effect.
I990112.name: Le Noir Contemporary Tiepin
I990112.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color> in the Symbolic
- Trigger Condition: Within 0.3 seconds of pressing the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> button, <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> in the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> direction reduces incoming <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 0

I990113.desc: Have you ever tasted the Golden Hide packed into the cracks? Oh, clothes seasoned with that hide... now that is a flavor one can never forget.
I990113.name: Le Rouge Casualwear Shoulder Bag

I990114.desc: Sometimes, gnawing away at the Golden Hide makes the crack wider. When that happens, you catch these nasty Noirs who tried to control the Hide. Stuff them into the gap, plug it up... And voilà, problem solved.
I990114.name: Le Rouge Casualwear Hoodie

I990115.desc: Someone once wondered, "What stood here before the Grand Magasin was built?" The thought was soon placed inside a cap, where it sank out of sight.
I990115.name: Le Rouge Contemporary Cap
I990115.statText:
In the Symbolic, unlocks <color=#F8C200>Evade</color>
- Press the <color=#F8C200>Evade button (Z on keyboard)</color> to <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> 1 tile in the direction of movement, or the direction currently faced while stationary (0.5 seconds cooldown)
- <color=#F8C200>Evade</color> triggers <color=#F8C200>Invul. Frame</color> for 0.2 seconds and can also be activated during attacks

I990116.desc: The Golden Hide may be consumed or worn. Hide is flesh itself; it quite literally lives and breathes. It is no different from the skin of our own bodies.
I990116.name: Le Rouge Contemporary Gloves

I990117.desc: A nail from a bygone season, driven into brick. It may once have been on trend, but now it is merely out-of-style.
I990117.name: Out-of-style Rouge Clothing

I990303.desc: I belong to neither Le Rouge nor Le Noir. Mine is a neutral value. Whichever brand comes seeking fabric, I will gladly trade with them.
I990303.name: Fabric from the Alteration Shop

I990304.desc: You put on sunglasses because the light is too bright. Then you look back into the sun. Sunglasses are not worn to avoid the sunlight, but to see it more clearly.
I990304.name: Boutique du Rouge Sunglasses
I990304.statText:
In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Weakpoint Attack</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +1

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +1

I990305.desc: When our God fell silent and the cracks yawned wider... some of us heard the Voice again.
I990305.name: Boutique du Rouge T-Shirt
I990305.statText:
In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> +5% upon landing an attack

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +1

I990306.desc: The Rouges favor a slim fit. What greater worth can fashion hold than laying bare the body's own lines?
I990306.name: Boutique du Rouge Denim

I990307.desc: What we offer—exquisite garments designed by the Noirs—conceals the customer's body and corrects the silhouette beneath. Fashion's worth lies in what it covers.
I990307.name: Maison du Noir Necktie

I990308.desc: This strange voice seems to drive whoever listens to it mad, be it a Noir or a Rouge.
I990308.name: Maison du Noir Slacks
I990308.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Invul. Frame</color> +0.05 seconds when hit

I990309.desc: The Grand Magasin is filled with Mannequins. Before the sunlight began leaking through the cracks, they all had two arms and two legs, and garments were made to fit that shape.
I990309.name: Maison du Noir Shirt
I990309.statText:
Upon entering battle in the Shadowed, inflicts 2 <color=#F8C200>Tremor</color> Potency and +2 <color=#F8C200>Tremor</color> Count on all enemies

During battle in the Shadowed: When an ally takes a hit, the ally gains +2 <color=#F8C200>Charge</color> Count (5 times per turn)

I990310.desc: Cages bring freedom into beeeeeeing. Without cages, freedom is meaninglessssss
I990310.name: Birdcage
I990310.statText:
In the Symbolic, 20% chance of <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -20% when hit (rounded down)

Upon entering battle in the Shadowed, all Sinners gain +4 <color=#F8C200>Charge</color> Count

I990311.desc: The vertebra of an employee who waited desperately for the Voice. A nail exists to hold things fast. Bone holds flesh in place. Bone is a nail. A nail pierces like a needle. This vertebra is not only a quality nail but also a needle.
I990311.name: Red Nail

I990312.desc:
By sheathing the vertebrae, the primordial, in civilization's most exalted material, this Golden Nail was created.
This needle pierces every boundary, from the lowest to the highest. Then it tears.
I990312.name: Golden Nail

I990313.desc: "Now faith is the substance of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen."
I990313.name: Faith
I990313.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon taking <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> that would result in death, 10% chance to survive with 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Excluding certain damages such as Instant Death

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

I990315.desc: Some seek a peaceful sleep inside the birdcage.
I990315.name: Blanket
I990315.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -20% when hit while <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color>

I990316.desc: A sharp sizzle. Warm blood. Meat running with juice. Anticipation of flavors and experiences yet to come.
I990316.name: Boutique du Rouge Earrings

I990317.desc: If the Crimson God's crimson Voice can no longer be heard, then make it heard. This is the cherished wish of the Rouges... and their appointed labor.
I990317.name: Boutique du Rouge Necklace
I990317.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon <color=#F8C200>Evading</color>, 20% chance to trigger a <color=#F8C200>Lightning Strike Extra Attack</color> (0.5 seconds Hitstun)
- Lightning Strike deals 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 1 random enemy within 3 tiles

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

I990318.desc: To build up. To cover. To conceal. To protect. To preserve. Such are the steadfast virtues of Le Noir.
I990318.name: Maison du Noir Top Hat
I990318.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> range +1 tile

I990319.desc: Wherever you go, I will snip-snip with these blossom shears until the path beneath you blooms with fallen blossoms.
I990319.name: Blossom Scissors
I990319.statText: In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger <color=#F8C200>Blossom Scissors-snip Extra Attack</color> dealing 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> upon landing an attack (0.3 seconds Hitstun)

I990320.desc: If a garment is made from the most worthy and meaningful material of all... does that make the garment as exalted as the material?
I990320.name: Golden Fabric

I990321.desc: A recorded Voice flows from the machine. It flows, yet remains imprisoned. Even a Voice can be nailed in place.
I990321.name: Old Recorder
I990321.statText: Upon entering battle in the Shadowed, all allies on the field <color=#F8C200>heal 4 SP</color>

I990322.desc: A bird spent its entire life singing into a horn. One day, it thrust its head into the horn and sang until it died. The next bird was made to sing from inside a cage.
I990322.name: Dead Bird

I990323.desc: It's strange that shoes require socks. We wear shoes to protect our feet, yet we place another layer between the foot and the shoe to protect them both? Or... perhaps that excess is what gives socks their dignity. Shoes belong to instinct—we need shoes because our feet hurt without them, while socks fall within the realm of civilization because we want the comfort.
I990323.name: Socks

I990401.desc: Names fade inside Grand Magasin Sisyphe. Only the names of products and brands remain. That is why one must dress in ever more layers.
I990401.name: Le Noir Mary Janes

I990402.desc: Fix me in place. Draw me tight. Bestow form on this unstable body. I offer up my freedom to you.
I990402.name: Le Noir Jodhpur Boots
I990402.statText:
<color=#F8C200>Hitstun</color> +0.1 seconds for attacks in the Symbolic

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

I990403.desc: The world must not change. It must remain exactly where it is. Forever.
I990403.name: Le Noir Classic Last
I990403.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon taking <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> that would result in death, <color=#00ff9c>survive with 1 HP</color> (once)
- Rest at the Fount to recharge
- Excluding certain damages such as Instant Death

I990404.desc: Many kinds of clothing exist, but shoes matter most. They are the first garments that touch the world.
I990404.name: Le Rouge Ballet Flats
I990404.statText:
In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> +30% upon killing an enemy

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +3

I990405.desc: Shoes need to breathe. The Noirs have it wrong—footwear shouldn't be sealed shut. They need to stay supple and let the feet breathe. Only then can you truly stand upon the earth. Otherwise, you're merely laid upon it, cut off from the ground below.
I990405.name: Le Rouge Chelsea Boots
I990405.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Avant</color> in the Symbolic
- Avant: Press the Attack button once more after the last Attack to activate <color=#F8C200>Avant</color>
- Upon activating Avant, performs a wide front sweep to <color=#F8C200>Knockback</color> enemies hit
- When activated during <color=#F8C200>Garde</color>, <color=#F8C200>Attack Range</color> and <color=#F8C200>Knockback Distance</color> increase based on Garde level

I990406.desc:
Food, clothing, shelter. Where does furniture belong? Is it something we dwell in, or something we wear like clothing?
Oh, neither. Furniture is the bridge between clothing and shelter.
I990406.name: Recliner
I990406.statText:
<color=#00ff9c>Heals</color> 1 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> every 15 seconds since last taking <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> (max 4)
- Rest at the Fount to recharge

I990407.desc: Customers and employees who wished to stop thinking became furnishings in Grand Magasin Sisyphe. Then the cracks began to widen, and when the fierce sunlight spilled through and whispered to them, the furnishings were torn from sleep and forced to move.
I990407.name: Mattress
I990407.statText:
In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -1 when hit while standing still (min 1)

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

I990408.desc: A Rouge wretch once asked why we sit at a table to eat. Why go to such trouble instead of eating off the floor? Well, the ceremony makes food taste better. What is won through hardship and patience is sweeter, and therefore more valuable. By that logic, the more uncomfortable the table and chair, the more civilized the diner. Wouldn't you agree?
I990408.name: Solid Wood Table
I990408.statText:
In the Symbolic, 15% chance to trigger an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> upon landing an attack (0.2 seconds Hitstun)
- Deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to the 5 tiles in a cross centered on the enemy hit
- Trigger Chance +10% for each enemy within 1 tile that has detected Meursault

I990409.desc: The organ that once allowed the Happy Closet to taste.
I990409.name: Tongue

I990410.desc: The bones that once allowed the Happy Closet to support itself.
I990410.name: Bundle of Bones

I990411.desc: The object that once allowed the Happy Closet to walk.
I990411.name: Shank

I990412.desc: The organ that once allowed the Happy Closet to digest food.
I990412.name: Tangled Entrails

I990413.desc: The organ that once allowed the Happy Closet to behold the beauty of the world.
I990413.name: An Eyeball

I990414.desc: The organs that once allowed the Happy Closet to behold the ugliness of the world.
I990414.name: Two Eyeballs

I990415.desc: That which once allowed the Happy Closet to reveal its feelings through expression.
I990415.name: Facial Skin

I990416.desc: The mechanism that once allowed the Happy Closet's organs, bones, items, and entrails to come and function together.
I990416.name: Blood Vessel Mesh

I990417.desc: Shoes that bring anyone home. The faint aroma scattered by each footfall is steeped in longing, for whoever wears them begins to yearn for the farthest place from home. After all, the more one longs for home, the closer to home one inevitably draws.
I990417.name: Pink Mary Janes
I990417.statText:
Pwie's Pulsation Potency +1 during battle in the Shadowed
- Min & Max Speed +3
- "Crimson Nail" Coin +1 (On Hit using additional Coins, fire <color=#F8C200>Petal Projectiles</color>)
- Upon using the "Perk Up" Skill, gain +1 Atk Weight for every 2 Pulsation Potency (max 2)
- Unlock the "Grab My Hand" Skill (used automatically when an ally is Staggered to <color=#F8C200>recover them from Stagger</color> and <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> their <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>; 2 times per turn)

I990418.desc: A shoe must protect its wearer without fault. It must hold them upright upon the earth, steady and unshaken. The world is dangerous; on unstable ground, the shoe is the final bastion of stability.
I990418.name: Le Noir Footwear Hall Wingtip Shoes
I990418.statText:
In the Symbolic, using Level 2 or higher <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> triggers <color=#F8C200>Dash</color> 3 tiles forward
- Stops early if an obstacle blocks the path

I990419.desc: Care Instructions: Noir shoes are made of stone. Stone shoes are hard and do not break. However, they scratch easily, so you must conceal marks with polish. Heavily scratched shoes look old; old-looking shoes appear structurally fragile, and structurally fragile-looking shoes may break.
I990419.name: Le Noir Footwear Hall Shoe Polish

I990420.desc: More feet mean more shoes to wear. Isn't that a good thing? Since when has having fewer legs become a mark of honor in the Footwear Hall? In the old days, the more legs one had, the better it was. Seriously, what's the world coming to?
I990420.name: Le Rouge Footwear Hall Sandals

I990421.desc: Laces close the shoe's mouth and hide its tongue. They stitch the mouth shut and pull it tight so that it cannot come undone. Bound so firmly, the shoe may be unable to speak... But this allows for the shape of one's foot to be laid bare.
I990421.name: Le Rouge Footwear Hole Shoelaces

I990422.desc: A chair that shatters the moment one sits. That is why it is expensive. One purchases it knowing it will break.
I990422.name: Glass Chair
I990422.statText: In the Symbolic, 「Solid Wood Table」<color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> range +1 tile (both vertical and horizontal)

I990423.desc: Envious of the sun's radiance, it became a lamp. Yet a lamp must stay closer to people than the sun, because the sun is too dazzling and hot to keep at one's side.
I990423.name: The Lights
I990423.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -2 when hit while standing still (min 1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> taken)

I990424.desc: This tote has plenty of room and can hold anything without issue. Bags made of hide may seem stretched to match the size of whatever is inside, but the hide does not truly stretch. It merely grows more pliant.
I990424.name: Le Rouge Handbags Hall Tote Bag
I990424.statText: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Parry</color>, fires 1 <color=#F8C200>Homing Projectile</color> at the nearest enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>

I990425.desc: When the Rouges resolved to fashion the Crimson God, countless bags were requisitioned. The hide stripped from their dismantled bodies had the honor of becoming part of the Cradle.
I990425.name: Le Rouge Handbags Hall Shoulder Bag
I990425.statText: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Parry</color>, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 against the target whose attack is <color=#F8C200>Parried</color>

I990426.desc: An alien shard of metal wedged between pieces of hide. The buckle exists to perform what hide alone cannot. Hide is flesh. The buckle is bone.
I990426.name: Le Rouge Handbags Hall Buckle

I990427.desc: Countless materials may be dedicated to the creation of a god, but the resulting Giant will never be able to escape the Grand Magasin's laws. To wield authority equal to that of other gods, it should never have been born here. Not as just another material for the department store.
I990427.name: Le Noir Handbags Hall Clutch Bag
I990427.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Blocking</color> a melee attack deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to the attacker

I990428.desc: Even so, it must be stopped. A fledgling god is still a god. Allow that thing to exist, and it will only drive the Rouges to gnaw away and devour still more Golden Resin.
I990428.name: Le Noir Handbags Hall Backpack
I990428.statText: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color>, triggers an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> that deals 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile of Meursault (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

I990429.desc: They say the Noirs' Brand Manager could not presently move between floors in person, so only the nearest available employees were sent to the Luxury Hall. I wonder whether we managed to bring the situation there under control.
I990429.name: Le Noir Handbags Hall Bag Strap
I990429.statText: In the Symbolic, upon a successful <color=#F8C200>Perfect Block</color>, knocks back enemies within 1 tile of Meursault by 1 tile

I990431.desc: This is too hard... There are so many... Too many will make it less fun... Too many shiny surfaces... won't make the shine special anymore...
I990431.name: Luminous Shoes
I990431.statText: After <color=#F8C200>Evading</color> in the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +3 on the next attack (10 seconds cooldown)

I990432.desc: Pull the cord, and the light turns on. Pull it again, and the light goes dark. The lamp is bound to the cord. This is what cords and nails share... and what sets them apart.
I990432.name: Lamp Pull Cord
I990432.statText: If player did not move for 3 seconds in the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 for the next attack (10 seconds cooldown)

I990501.desc: The Sisyphe System is an apparatus built to extract experience from prisoners efficiently and without violence. Within it, prisoners undergo a multitude of experiences, and the variety becomes the base ingredient of Experience Dough. Experience is the perception of change: an unbroken alternation between stillness and motion. Le Noir governs stillness.
I990501.name: Obedience
I990501.statText:
During battle in the Shadowed, immediately before an Identity that has 50% or lower <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> is hit by an enemy Skill, the said Identity gains Shield equal to 20% of its missing <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Once per Identity per Encounter
- This Shield does not expire after the turn ends

I990801.desc: The Luxury Hall is under attack! The Rouges have stormed the Hall held by the Noirs and have now begun a feast!
I990801.name: Soda Pop
I990801.statText:
If Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> drops to 5 or lower, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 5 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> (once)
- Rest at the Fount to recharge

I990802.desc: Consumption requires a passage from there to here. To consume is to draw something out of another and into oneself. That is why pleasure follows.
I990802.name: Straw
I990802.statText:
In the Symbolic, 10% chance to <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> 1 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> upon landing an attack

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

I990803.desc: What the Food Court produces may be a scrumptious dish, yet it ceases to be a meal. The fault lies not with the cooking, but with where it is eaten. It is a conundrum of the structure.
I990803.name: "You Hear?"
I990803.statText:
In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> upon landing an attack
- Deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 1 random enemy within 4 tiles of the enemy hit

I990804.desc: Le Kaki's flagship product. For a brand struggling to create fashion, the umbrella is no more than one of its few true creations.
I990804.name: Folding Umbrella
I990804.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon landing an attack on a destructible projectile, <color=#F8C200>destroys the projectile</color>

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +2

I990805.desc: It is hard to imagine what one could accomplish with a single piece of tissue paper. Somewhere, however, someone is said to be able to finish their business in the restroom with just one.
I990805.name: A Piece of Tissue Paper

I990806.desc: The strangers are trying to kill me, you hear?! We could've settled this by talking, but they want me dead, you hear?!
I990806.name: Button
I990806.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon triggering "You Hear?" <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color>, number of projectile +1

During battle in the Shadowed, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 15 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> and 10 SP for the ally that killed an enemy

I990807.desc: Savory flavor really brings up the appetite, you hear? Once you feel that appetite, you start craving the next dish, you hear? Craving the next dish means looking forward to the next flavor, you hear? So, savory means anticipation, you hear?
I990807.name: It's Savory, You Hear?

I990808.desc: Toasty is an aroma, not a flavor, you hear? Aroma and taste are different, but they cling together, you hear? Someday, I'll cook a dish made only of aroma, you hear?  Then everyone here can have their fill without worrying about food running out, you hear?
I990808.name: It's Toasty, You Hear?
I990808.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 3 Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> upon killing an enemy (4 seconds cooldown)

I990809.desc:
Things of eld are beached upon the Shore. They are not of the Grand Magasin, but remnants of the previous age, broken and fated to break further.
For this place is now a department store built from another's design.
I990809.name: Fishing Rod
I990809.statText:
In the Symbolic, 30% chance to trigger <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Extra Attack</color>, dealing 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> upon landing an attack (1 second Hitstun)
- Triggers <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Extra Attack</color> on 1 random enemy within 3 tiles of the enemy hit (3 times max)

I990810.desc: The Aquarium once held countless fish and tanks of every kind. Scales, waters, and glass enclosures threaded through environments of every variety. Lowest of all flowed water woven from Blackthread, and within it slept a fish in silence.
I990810.name: Scoop Net
I990810.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon killing an enemy, 20% chance to generate <color=#F8C200>Black Larva</color>
- <color=#F8C200>Black Larva</color> crawls to the nearest enemy within 10 tiles
- When it touches an enemy, or if it fails to touch an enemy within 3 seconds, detonates on the spot
- Upon detonation, deal 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile

I990811.desc: The larvae that survived long enough to wash ashore caught the scent of chum. They tried to crawl onto the Shore, only to be cooked in the heat of the open air. This is a world outside the waters. The Age of the Aquarium is over, and the Age of the Department Store must now be endured.
I990811.name: Paste Bait
I990811.statText:
Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +4

In the Symbolic, activates Level 2 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>
- All motions and effects are applied as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>

I990812.desc: It brought far too many things into being, and thus, grave is its sin. To give birth to so much is no different from killing just as much. And so the thing of eld that once swam through the Blackthread quietly brooded over its eggs at the lowest depths, propagating its sins.
I990812.name: Black Water of the Shore
I990812.statText:
In the Symbolic, unlocks Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Projectile</color>
- Fires at the nearest enemy within 5 tiles (2.5 seconds cooldown)
- On hit, deals a total of 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> over 3 seconds

In Shadowed Battle, Pwie's Pulsation Potency +1
- After using "Perk Up", if in Uncontrollable Rampage and at 10+ Pulsation Count, consume 10 Pulsation Count to apply 1 <color=#F8C200>Base Power Up</color> on the target
- When using "Don't Get Hurty" and at 3+ Pulsation Potency, gain Atk Weight +2; On Hit, heal SP equal to Skill Power
- Unlocks "Baptism of Crimson Nails" (attacks 3 enemies)

I990813.desc: ... I don't understand. You tried to kill Meursault, Dante, and me when we first met. I need something from you... but you won't give it, so there's really no other way, right? You die because... because you're evil... And weak, too. So why do I feel so awful? You did the same thing—Why... why am I the only one left to feel this guilt?
I990813.name: Clean Apron
I990813.statText:
In the Symbolic, enhance Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Projectile</color>
- Generate <color=#F8C200>Blackwater Tile</color> within 1 tile of the landing point (duration: 5 seconds)
- Enemies on top of affected tiles:
  - Take 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> every 2 seconds 
  - Movement Speed -20%

During battle in the Shadowed, enhance Pwie's "Baptism of Crimson Nails" Skill
- On Use, Base Power +1 for every 4 <color=#F8C200>Bleed</color> on target (max 2)

I990814.desc:
A map outlining a direct inroad into the Luxury Hall, but it is now used and illegible. Sisyphe System is, as a whole, a superposition of layers upon layers, which is precisely what permits it to house an implausible number of customers.
Created by the few minds able to analyze the many-tiered structure, this map is of astronomical worth.

And it fell into the Rouges' hand.
I990814.name: Map Fragment
I990814.statText: Upon entering battle in the Shadowed, gain 1 <color=#F8C200>E.G.O Resource Amp</color> for 1 turn

I990815.desc:
Do you know where food ends and scraps begin?

Take one bite and throw the rest away, and it becomes refuse. But to some, that waste becomes a wonderfully rare ingredient, devoured with delight. What I mean is, what counts as scraps is an incredibly important issue in the Food Court... and right now, anything that isn't Noir is considered scraps.
I990815.name: Food Scraps
I990815.statText:
During battle in the Shadowed:
Turn Start: Ally that has lower than 50% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> gains 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP Healing</color> Boost (4 times per Encounter)

I990901.desc:
To sew, we need a needle.
And what are needles but another name for nails? Sewing is a form of affixation, and that's what needles are used for... Just like nails.
I990901.name: Pincushion

I990902.desc: Needlekins serve a king. The king is a gourmet, and he demands that his subjects stab endlessly. Stabbing is a barometer that measures worth through the delicacy's moans of delight and screeches of pain. Needlekins stab as their king commands, and quietly lap up the secretions.
I990902.name: Needlekin's Nail
I990902.statText:
Hitstun +0.2 seconds for Attacks in the Symbolic

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +1

I990904.desc: Gotta clean myself before getting dressed. Don't be scared to be a little rough—you gotta scrub the crevices hard.
I990904.name: Tongue Scraper
I990904.statText: In the Symbolic, upon killing an enemy, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2 on the next attack

I990905.desc: These stupid needles must all be insane. Stab stab stab—that's all they know. They see something they don't like? Stab! That's what they do. And when something oozes out, they lick it up. Glad I've got a thimble with me... I would've been in quite a pickle had I been caught down here without it.
I990905.name: Naked's Thimble
I990905.statText: In the Symbolic, <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Taken -2 when hit (10 seconds cooldown)

I990906.desc:
A board on which dyes of many kinds are placed.

Basic colors are mixed upon it to create the desired shade. The right proportions and speed are essential to make what is wanted.

The smell of all that mingled pus is quite colorful.
I990906.name: Palette
I990906.statText:
When hit in the Symbolic, creates <color=#F8C200>Red-Dyed Tiles</color> within 1 tile of Meursault.
- Enemies standing on these tiles take 1 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> every 2 seconds

I990907.desc: A long brush is needed to mix tears. Use a brush too short, and the arms might sink into them and be sucked under. One must be wary that they are not submerged in tears, for they will cry and cry until the colors leach out.
I990907.name: Long Brush
I990907.statText: In the Symbolic, landing <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> on an enemy extends the attack 1 tile behind the enemy hit

I990908.desc:
One needs a large brush to paint a diverse spectrum of colors. Smaller brushes naturally lend themselves to more brushstrokes, but one must keep the number of strokes to a minimum. Each daub of the brush leaves tear droplets on me, and with them, its scent.

The scent makes me cry, but I keep painting. I paint for the one who has forgotten tears and pain.
I990908.name: Large Brush
I990908.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> in the Symbolic
- Hold the Attack button for a set duration, then release to perform a high-damage <color=#F8C200>Garde</color>
- Garde Charge Time: 2 seconds
- Garde Damage: Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> +1 in the Symbolic
- <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> is reduced to 50% during Garde

I990909.desc: Tissue paper serves two purposes on this floor: to be pierced, or to soak up tears. It is thin enough to puncture easily, yet full of enough tiny holes to soak up a great deal of pus.
I990909.name: Two Tissue Papers

I990910.desc:
Anything that comes out when pierced is juice. Drink it. Poke and pop the bubble of tears and drink what bursts forth. Or pierce someone else and make them weep pus.
The flavor follows the taste of sorrow.
I990910.name: Juice
I990910.statText:
In the Symbolic, changes the <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> reduction during <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> to 25%

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +1

I990911.desc:
A toothbrush whose head is a forest of spindly nails.

The nails grate the skin, ripping and breaking through what is embedded. This drains the subdermal fluid.

Then, it is brought to the king for tasting.
I990911.name: Toothbrush of the King of Needleworks
I990911.statText:
In the Symbolic, triggers an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> every 1 second against enemies pursuing Meursault
- Deals 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 1 random pursuing enemy within 5 tiles
- Does not target enemies that are patrolling or fleeing
- Does not trigger while <color=#F8C200>Sprinting</color>

I990912.desc: One carries enough tears to burst; the other, not a drop.
I990912.name: Mordant
I990912.statText:
In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Sprinting</color> leaves behind <color=#F8C200>Yellow Pus Tiles</color> that last for 3 seconds
- Enemies standing on these tiles have Movement Speed -30%

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +4

I990913.desc: On the day cracks formed on the walls, on the day the Voice leached in, the siblings each made a different wish. One wished to never hurt again. The other wished to never be sad again. The one freed from hurt can now be soaked in tears, for it is not pain that draws tears.
I990913.name: Dyestuff
I990913.statText:
In the Symbolic, landing <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> triggers an <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color> (1 second Hitstun)
- Deals 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> to 1 random enemy within 3 tiles of the enemy hit
- After triggering the <color=#F8C200>Extra Attack</color>, (80 - trigger count x 20)% chance to trigger again on 1 random enemy within 1 tile of the target hit
- Can be chained (max 5 times; 10% minimum trigger chance)

In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> range +1 tile

I990914.desc:
Those who are freed from sadness forget tears.
They become dry, rigid, and cutting.
I990914.name: Cartilage
I990914.statText:
Unlocks Level 3 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> in the Symbolic
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> Time: 3 seconds
- <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>: Attack <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> +3 in the Symbolic

In the Symbolic, <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> <color=#F8C200>Dash</color> distance +2 tiles

I990915.desc: Over time, the Floor Manager's form warped into a shape suited to the endless turning of the spinning wheel. That same will protected her from becoming a mindless Mannequin, splitting her into three parts. The three are, in fact, one. We, too, are all but wholes of parts ourselves.
I990915.name: Naildle
I990915.statText:
In the Symbolic, unlocks <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color> for <color=#F8C200>Avant</color>

- Upon triggering <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>, Symbolic <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt +2, Hitstun +0.1s, and <color=#00ff9c>heals</color> 1 <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>
- Enemies defeated by this attack are knocked back 5 tiles instead of becoming corpses on the spot
- If the enemy collides during knockback, it immediately explodes, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile, then becomes a corpse
- If no collision occurs, it explodes at the end of the knockback, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile, then becomes a corpse

I990916.desc:
They turn the wheel to spin the thread.

They have done so for so long that causality itself has warped into itself. Does one spin thread to turn the wheel, or turn the wheel to spin thread? The question has become unanswerable, but it does not matter. On this floor, the "why" is of little significance. The Floor Manager's role begins and ends with a singular function: to spin thread and give it to its recipient. Thus, the spinning wheel does not stop even when the spinners die. The thread waits here for the arrival of the nail, to tether the here to the there.
I990916.name: Spinning Wheel
I990916.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Needle Projectile</color> in the Symbolic
- Fires a projectile dealing 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> against the farthest enemy within 10 tiles (cooldown 3 seconds, 0.5 seconds Hitstun)
- When the projectile hits, fires another Projectile against a nearby enemy with a (100 / number of times the effect triggers)% chance

During battle in the Shadowed, Pwie gains 1 Pulsation Potency
- On "Go Away" Skill Use, Atk Weight +1 for every 2 Pulsation Potency (max 2)

I990917.desc:
Thread and needle. B2F was built from the need for these two concepts.

Thread seeks to penetrate the needle, while the needle longs to be penetrated. To handle the essence, one must draw close to the essence oneself; therefore, the deeper one descends to the basement, the clarity of existence blurs and segments until it is reduced to a collection of bits.
Though the concept of thread and needle does, indeed, approach the essence of clothing closely, it is not the same as the essence. The dissolving of the Alterationist, who handles thread, is an inevitable fate.
I990917.name: Straight Pin of the King of Needleworks
I990917.statText:
In the Symbolic, upon landing <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color>, inflict <color=#F8C200>Mark of the King of Needleworks</color>
- Inflicts this effect only when there are no targets that have this <color=#F8C200>Mark</color>
- Mark of the King of Needleworks duration: 5 seconds
- Affected target Movement Speed -30%
- When the affected target is killed, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 3 tiles (0.1 seconds Hitstun)
- After the effect duration expires, removes the Mark and deals 5 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>
- If that Damage kills the affected target, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

I990918.desc: Is taste... that important? You don't know if Wriggley's gonna be tasty or not. If you wanna eat Wriggley anyway... have you eaten Wriggley before? But... taste is changing all the time. Why do you think Wriggley'll taste the same again? And... Wriggley's right here. No one's eaten Wriggley. Weird...
I990918.name: Clew of the King of Needleworks
I990918.statText:
In the Symbolic, enhance Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Needle Projectile</color>
- Punches through enemies in its trajectory, dealing 2 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color>

During battle in the Shadowed, enhance Pwie's "Perk Up" Skill
- On Hit, instead of applying <color=#F8C200>Clash Power Up</color>, apply 1 <color=#F8C200>Base Power Up</color>
- Applies <color=#F8C200>Offense Level Up</color> applied On Hit next turn as well

I990919.desc: Repeat automatically. Simply execute. May this repetition, at least, prove convenient to you.
I990919.name: Repetition
I990919.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Auto-attack</color> in the Symbolic.

Press the Auto-attack (T on keyboard) button to toggle ON/OFF. Detects enemies based on character orientation and <color=#F8C200>automatically uses the Basic Attack</color>
- Detection Range: 4 tiles ahead, 1 tile each left & right
- Prioritizes other actions such as Move or Block; resumes Auto-attack when other actions are completed
- Removes post-attack movement delay regardless of toggling
- Automatically toggled OFF when:
  - Moving between floors
  - Entering a battle in the Shadowed

I990922.desc: What do you think the walls of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe are made of?
I990922.name: "Bwahahaha!"
I990922.statText:
During battle in the Shadowed:
Allies deal +5% <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> against Sisyphe enemies

I990923.desc: A thread twined from thinly sliced Meursault. Its color is quite familiar.
I990923.name: Thread
I990923.statText:
In the Symbolic, for 5 seconds upon landing an attack:
- Target's <color=#F8C200>Movement Speed</color> -10%
- Target's <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> Dealt -2 

(15 second cooldown)

I990924.desc: Isn't it funny that the people of the Grand Magasin Sisyphe call this dye "sky-blue" when none of them can see the sky in here? Besides, there's no such thing as "sky-color"—the real sky changes color with the time of day, the weather, or... the observer's heart.
I990924.name: Sky-blue Dye
I990924.statText:
During battle in the Shadowed:
After winning an Encounter, <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> 10% Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color>

I990925.desc:
Why does one stumble in the dark for the crumbs of meaning?
Does one find meaning inherent in the crumbs, or does the search itself imbue them with one?
I990925.name: Sawdust
I990925.statText: <color=#F8C200>Hitstun</color> +0.2 seconds for Attacks in the Symbolic

I990926.desc: Vibrant red, austere black, drifting khaki... all colors are bound to follow wherever the needle leads.
I990926.name: Colorful Skein

I990934.desc: What is invisible must be coated in color until its outline emerges. Splash enough unseen things with color, and one realizes that one's own body has become stained.
I990934.name: Dirty Apron
I990934.statText:
In the Symbolic, changes the HP threshold for displaying enemy HP bars to 100%
- While owned, enemy HP bars are displayed from the first hit onward

I991004.desc: The Golden Hide is an object of power. Minds may teeter on the brink of descent into a Mannequin, yet the Golden Hide gives them consciousness, guiding them to become a complete Distortion.
I991004.name: Palette's Golden Resin

I991005.desc: A Distortion that has reached the terminus acquires a language only it can understand. It cannot communicate with others with such a language.
I991005.name: B2F Floor Manager's Golden Hide

I991006.desc: Though ages passed, it did not devolve into a Mannequin; instead, aided by the Golden Hide, it remained a sapient Distortion.
I991006.name: Golden Hide of the King of Needleworks

I991007.desc: Why does the light, bleeding out of the Golden Hide, act as an anchor to the Mannequins' sapience? Should it not instead hasten their descent into mindless Distortions?
I991007.name: Sous Chef's Golden Hide

I991008.desc:
Paradoxically, the golden light wishes for all Distortions to reach their terminus, and at the same time, it does not.
What dwells within the light is more than a single entity, and neither is the heart inside one of them.
I991008.name: Golden Hide from the Corpse Pile

I991009.desc:
Distortions can remain sapient and convey their wills to others through various avenues of communication.
That the light does not obliterate their wisdom is an irony, and may betray a glimpse of the humanity still dwelling within it.
I991009.name: Le Rouge Brand Director's Golden Hide

I991010.desc: Through dialogue with the light, customers who carried a piece of the Golden Hide gained powers beyond those of others, which allowed them to expand their influence throughout the Grand Magasin.
I991010.name: 3F Floor Manager's Golden Hide

I991011.desc:
Le Néant's purpose goes beyond the deconstruction of this department store.
They desire the full, unhindered embrace of the light.
I991011.name: Golden Hide from the Crack in the Wall

I991012.desc: A shearling cape that preserves the fur of the Golden Hide. This garment keeps what comes from outside at bay, while hastening what blooms within. Once the child dons it, childhood reaches its end. The child learns what others expect and what must be restored, and is compelled to act accordingly. It is no longer permitted to be curious about the world.
I991012.name: Golden Shroud
I991012.statText:
In the Symbolic, Pwie leaves <color=#F8C200>Le Vomissement</color> in their tracks
- Enemies 1 tile within Pwie and enemies on top of <color=#F8C200>Le Vomissement</color> take 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> every 2 seconds
- Inflicts <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color> on all enemies who took <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> from this effect
- When enemies that have <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color> dies, they deal 4 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile around them (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

During battle in the Shadowed:
- Pwie gains 1 Pulsation Potency
- Defense Level +10
- Turn End: If Pwie is Staggered, recover from Stagger and <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> 50% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> (once per Encounter)
- On Hit using "Crimson Nail (2nd Coin)", "Go Away", or "Baptism of Crimson Nails", inflict 1 <color=#F8C200>Golden Revelation</color>
- On "Baptism of Crimson Nails" use, at 5+ Pulsation Potency, gain +2 Atk Weight and Coin Power +(Pulsation Potency - 3)
- Upon using "Don't Get Hurty", additionally <color=#00ff9c>heal</color> (Pulsation Potency x 2)% <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> and (Pulsation Potency x 3) SP
- On Hit using "Grab My Hand", apply Shield equal to 50% of target's max <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> next turn

I991013.desc: As flesh is stripped from bone, hide is peeled from flesh. Then the hair clinging to it must be dissolved away until only the raw skin remains.
I991013.name: Bundle of Rawhide

I991014.desc: Hide takes on the color of tan as tannins transform it inside the Tannery.
I991014.name: Tanned Hide

I991015.desc: Hide is the process by which meat becomes plant. The flesh dissolves, and branches of wood fill the hollows left behind.
I991015.name: Supple Hide

I991016.desc: The reason the Rouges desire hide is simple. Hide is depletion; fabric is excess. They eat the meat, then wear what remains, never wondering what happens when nothing is left to eat. Consume now. Wear now. The Rouges worship depletion. They do not walk toward depletion because they love hide. They came to wear hide because depletion was always its destination.
I991016.name: Alteration Tools
I991016.statText:
In the Symbolic, unlock <color=#F8C200>Overseer Projectiles</color>
- Fired to a random enemy within 5 tiles (2.5 seconds cooldown)
- On hitting the target, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 1 tile (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

In Shadowed Battles, unlock "I'll End It for You..." for Pwie
- If an enemy is not killed by an Attack Skill, use it on that enemy (once per turn)
- Deal +0.5% <color=#fe4b48>damage</color> for every 1% missing <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> on target (max 30%)

I991017.desc:
Soot left behind by something that does not belong to the department store.

The Sisyphe System has changed its form time and again with each passing age. Grand Magasin Sisyphe is simply the form one of its Giants—namely the Architect, who was also an Alterationist—deemed the most convenient and suitable for realization within the Symbolic.

Depending on who is assigned to this position, the Sisyphe System may take the form of a department store, an aquarium, a gas station, a cave, a mountain range, or something else entirely.

Whether it is a department store or a cave is beside the point. Whatever shape it takes, the Sisyphe System will always construct some means of creating a "drop", or fluctuations, within itself. All the Giant needs is a perspective capable of imagining such a structure.
I991017.name: Soot
I991017.statText:
In the Symbolic, activates Level 3 <color=#F8C200>Garde</color> as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>
- All motions and effects are applied as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>
- When player has 「Paste Bait」, motion is applied as <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color>
- When this effect activates, triggers both <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 2</color> effect and <color=#F8C200>Attack Chain 3</color> effect

I991018.desc:
When the Aquarium transformed into the Grand Magasin, every remnant of the Aquarium should have disappeared with it. Yet something remained—something that still remembers its time there. For the Sisyphe System, which had long been believed to be flawless, this is a defect that must be resolved.

For whatever reason, the fish that was left behind without ever becoming a customer will remain a fish, no matter how many times the Grand Magasin resets.

To correct this flaw within the Sisyphe System, the Sinner responsible for that fish would have to die.

But the Sisyphe System is at once a punishment device, a resource-harvesting apparatus, and an embodiment of N Corp.'s morality. By design, it cannot forcibly kill one of its own prisoners.
I991018.name: Voidbearing Eye
I991018.statText:
In the Symbolic, enhance Pwie's <color=#F8C200>Overseer Projectile</color>
- Upon landing the projectile, deals 3 <color=#fe4b48>Damage</color> within 2 tiles (0.1 seconds Hitstun)

I991019.desc:
At the very bottom of the department store, foul-smelling, brutal leatherwork takes place.

Hide is what remains after the traces of life have been stripped away. Left as it is, however, it does nothing but rot. Only through tanning does it cease to be something that still carries the warmth of the living, becoming instead a dense mass of fibers... something else entirely.
I991019.name: Tannin

I991020.desc:
There are fast ways and slow ways to process hides. In chrome tanning, the hide is steeped in chromium to hasten the process, drawing into itself a metal it would never have encountered in nature as it hardens.

It is fast, but having dragged time forward to gain that speed, it does not endure for long.
I991020.name: Chromium Salt

I991021.desc: The hide is steeped in plant-based tanning agents and cured slowly. It demands patience and time, but leather that endures such a lengthy process can, in turn, endure for far longer. Hide is, above all else, carnivorous in origin. And yet leather made this way is called veg-tan leather. It is finished by putting the vegetable into the carnivorous.
I991021.name: Oil
I991021.statText:
In the Symbolic, applies the <color=#F8C200>Block</color> effect during <color=#F8C200>Garde</color>

Symbolic <color=#00ff9c>HP</color> +4

I991022.desc:
The Golden Hide, then, could be described as a hide whose very structure is densely packed with minute bundles of gold. The Hide that once filled the cracks truly had been someone's skin and flesh. And once it was tanned, it came to take on arboreal properties befitting the Golden Bough.

But was the Golden Bough ever truly established to be a plant?
I991022.name: Golden Hide Fabric

I992702.desc: This dish grants the complete experience of being eaten. Tasting it brings death, for the taster has become consumed as prey.
I992702.name: Ruminations of the Prey

I992704.desc: The cocoon cries as if calling out to someone. Carried from a past now gone, the child washed ashore, drifted as far as the Food Court... and has now become a dish.
I992704.name: Golden Cocoon
I992704.statText:
Unlocks <color=#F8C200>Lantern</color> in the Symbolic
- Press the Lantern button (F on keyboard) to toggle the <color=#F8C200>Lantern</color> that illuminates the direction the character is facing

I992705.desc: Before the department store was built, a being of eld survived as if by miracle and left behind an offspring. That surviving descendant was beached on the Shore, there to become material for a new age.
I992705.name: Larva

I992806.desc:
There is a tear that, once every long while, is dredged up bloated from the deepest depths. After a long, grueling process of stirring through the rancid stench and the smudging black... the tear regains its original clarity.

The Deep-sea Dye is made from the tears of such olden beings.
I992806.name: Deep-sea Dye

I992807.desc:
Mix the secretion from the Golden Resin with the pus.

Each ounce of the golden is densely saturated with meaning and worth, enough to turn any dye just as aureate. The hard part is getting the secretion.
I992807.name: Golden Dye

I992808.desc: Woven threads wound for transport. Spin, spin, spin... In every step of its life, the thread spins.
I992808.name: Golden Skein

I993003.desc: The red, swollen tears burst like a pus-filled abscess.
I993003.name: Red Tears

I993004.desc: The blue dye smells of pus.
I993004.name: Blue Tears
